folded.id: allah|has|sent down to you the qur'an
folded.subject: Allah
folded.object: sent down to you the Qur'an

spans.text: Allah has sent down to you the Qur'an.

folded.id: allah|will|accomplish his purpose
folded.subject: Allah
folded.object: accomplish His purpose

spans.text: Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose.

folded.id: allah|will|have perfected for him a provision
folded.subject: Allah
folded.object: have perfected for him a provision

spans.text: Allah will have perfected for him a provision.

folded.id: among you|and|establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] allah
folded.subject: among you
folded.object: establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allah

spans.text: And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allah.

folded.id: and those|who|no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt
folded.subject: And those
folded.object: no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt

spans.text: [4] AR: وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔى يَئِسْنَ مِنَ ٱلْمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمْ إِنِ ٱرْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَٰثَةُ أَشْهُرٍۢ وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔى لَمْ يَحِضْنَ ۚ وَأُو۟لَٰتُ ٱلْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ يُسْرًۭا EN: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated.

folded.id: and|will|provide for him from where he does not expect
folded.subject: And
folded.object: provide for him from where he does not expect

spans.text: [3] AR: وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِۦ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدْرًۭا EN: And will provide for him from where he does not expect.

folded.id: during|that|period] unless they are committing a clear immorality
folded.subject: during
folded.object: period] unless they are committing a clear immorality

spans.text: Do not turn them out of their [husbands'] houses, nor should they [themselves] leave [during that period] unless they are committing a clear immorality.

folded.id: for those|who|are pregnant
folded.subject: for those
folded.object: are pregnant

spans.text: And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth.

folded.id: he|will|make for him a way out
folded.subject: He
folded.object: make for him a way out

spans.text: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out

folded.id: he|will|make for him of his matter ease
folded.subject: He
folded.object: make for him of his matter ease

spans.text: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him of his matter ease.

folded.id: he|will|remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward
folded.subject: He
folded.object: remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward

spans.text: [5] AR: ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُۥٓ أَجْرًا EN: That is the command of Allah, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allah - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward.

folded.id: in allah|and|does righteousness - he will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever
folded.subject: in Allah
folded.object: does righteousness - He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever

spans.text: And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever.

folded.id: it|is|allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth
folded.subject: It
folded.object: Allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth

spans.text: [12] AR: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ وَمِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًۢا EN: It is Allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them.

folded.id: its lord|and|his messengers
folded.subject: its Lord
folded.object: His messengers

spans.text: [8] AR: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِۦ فَحَاسَبْنَٰهَا حِسَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَعَذَّبْنَٰهَا عَذَابًۭا نُّكْرًۭا EN: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers, so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment.

folded.id: may know|that|allah is over all things competent and that allah has encompassed all things in knowledge
folded.subject: may know
folded.object: Allah is over all things competent and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge

spans.text: [His] command descends among them so you may know that Allah is over all things competent and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge.

folded.id: of allah|has|certainly wronged himself
folded.subject: of Allah
folded.object: certainly wronged himself

spans.text: And whoever transgresses the limits of Allah has certainly wronged himself.

folded.id: of understanding|who|have believed
folded.subject: of understanding
folded.object: have believed

spans.text: [10] AR: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۚ قَدْ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ذِكْرًۭا EN: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear Allah, O you of understanding who have believed.

folded.id: perhaps allah|will|bring about after that a [different] matter
folded.subject: perhaps Allah
folded.object: bring about after that a [different] matter

spans.text: You know not; perhaps Allah will bring about after that a [different] matter.
Allah will bring about, after hardship, ease.

folded.id: so we|took|it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment
folded.subject: so We
folded.object: it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment

spans.text: [8] AR: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِۦ فَحَاسَبْنَٰهَا حِسَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَعَذَّبْنَٰهَا عَذَابًۭا نُّكْرًۭا EN: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers, so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment.

folded.id: that|is|instructed to whoever should believe in allah and the last day
folded.subject: That
folded.object: instructed to whoever should believe in Allah and the Last day

spans.text: That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allah and the Last day.

[5] AR: ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُۥٓ أَجْرًا EN: That is the command of Allah, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allah - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward.

folded.id: their payment|and|confer among yourselves in the acceptable way
folded.subject: their payment
folded.object: confer among yourselves in the acceptable way

spans.text: And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for the father another woman.

folded.id: their period|is|three months
folded.subject: their period
folded.object: three months

spans.text: [4] AR: وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔى يَئِسْنَ مِنَ ٱلْمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمْ إِنِ ٱرْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَٰثَةُ أَشْهُرٍۢ وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔى لَمْ يَحِضْنَ ۚ وَأُو۟لَٰتُ ٱلْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ يُسْرًۭا EN: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated.

folded.id: their term|is|until they give birth
folded.subject: their term
folded.object: until they give birth

spans.text: And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth.

folded.id: then he|is|sufficient for him
folded.subject: then He
folded.object: sufficient for him

spans.text: And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.

folded.id: those|who|have not menstruated
folded.subject: those
folded.object: have not menstruated

spans.text: [4] AR: وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔى يَئِسْنَ مِنَ ٱلْمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمْ إِنِ ٱرْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَٰثَةُ أَشْهُرٍۢ وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔى لَمْ يَحِضْنَ ۚ وَأُو۟لَٰتُ ٱلْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ يُسْرًۭا EN: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated.

folded.id: waiting period|and|keep count of the waiting period
folded.subject: waiting period
folded.object: keep count of the waiting period

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحْصُوا۟ ٱلْعِدَّةَ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ ۖ لَا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِنۢ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخْرُجْنَ إِلَّآ أَن يَأْتِينَ بِفَٰحِشَةٍۢ مُّبَيِّنَةٍۢ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُۥ ۚ لَا تَدْرِى لَعَلَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرًۭا EN: O Prophet, when you [Muslims] divorce women, divorce them for [the commencement of] their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period, and fear Allah, your Lord.

folded.id: which he|has|sent down to you
folded.subject: which He
folded.object: sent down to you

spans.text: [5] AR: ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُۥٓ أَجْرًا EN: That is the command of Allah, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allah - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward.

folded.id: whose provision|is|restricted - let him spend from what allah has given him
folded.subject: whose provision
folded.object: restricted - let him spend from what Allah has given him

spans.text: [7] AR: لِيُنفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍۢ مِّن سَعَتِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُۥ فَلْيُنفِقْ مِمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَآ ءَاتَىٰهَا ۚ سَيَجْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍۢ يُسْرًۭا EN: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allah has given him.

folded.id: your means|and|do not harm them in order to oppress them
folded.subject: your means
folded.object: do not harm them in order to oppress them

spans.text: [6] AR: أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ ۚ وَإِن كُنَّ أُو۟لَٰتِ حَمْلٍۢ فَأَنفِقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ فَإِنْ أَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَـَٔاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ ۖ وَأْتَمِرُوا۟ بَيْنَكُم بِمَعْرُوفٍۢ ۖ وَإِن تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُۥٓ أُخْرَىٰ EN: Lodge them [in a section] of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them.
